Lemma
[Ricci evolution in general dimension] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0189, chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0190 1. Lemma 6.9\group evolution-of-curvature-under-the-ricci-flow

Under the Ricci flow, the Ricci tensor evolves by the Lichnerowicz heat equation \[ \frac{\partial }{\partial t}R_{jk}=\Delta _L R_{jk}=\Delta R_{jk}+2g^{pq}g^{rs}R_{pjkr}R_{qs}-2g^{pq}R_{jp}R_{qk}. \]
